jobs.title: Senior Geotechnical Engineer
jobs.description: Job Summary We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Geotechnical Engineer experienced in geotechnical engineering design, investigations, and construction support. The successful candidate will be responsible for delivering geotechnical solutions across infrastructure, transportation, buildings, and civil engineering projects, including site investigations, foundation design, earthworks, ground improvement, and advanced numerical analysis. The role requires close coordination with multidisciplinary teams while ensuring compliance with project specifications, applicable standards, and quality requirements. Key Responsibilities Perform engineering design and analysis for geotechnical projects with minimal supervision. Execute moderate to complex portions of multidisciplinary engineering assignments. Collect, interpret, and correlate geotechnical investigation data using established engineering procedures. Prepare engineering calculations, technical reports, design drawings, and specifications. Develop practical engineering solutions by adapting established methods to project-specific requirements. Identify design discrepancies, assess risks, and recommend corrective actions. Mentor and provide technical guidance to junior engineers. Deliver work in accordance with project budgets, schedules, and quality standards. Coordinate with structural, civil, environmental, and construction teams throughout project delivery. Provide technical support during construction, site inspections, and contractor coordination. The successful candidate should demonstrate expertise in: Planning and managing geotechnical investigations. Assessment and interpretation of geotechnical parameters. Development of geotechnical ground models for various design conditions. Shallow foundation design. Deep foundation design (piles and drilled shafts). Earthworks and embankment design. Slope stability assessment and design. Excavation and temporary lateral support systems. Ground improvement techniques and design. Liquefaction assessment and mitigation. Preparation of geotechnical design reports and recommendations. Construction monitoring and geotechnical site support. Qualifications Bachelor's Degree in Engineering or Science from an accredited university in one of the following disciplines: Geotechnical Engineering Civil Engineering Engineering Geology Geological Engineering Foundation Engineering Soil Mechanics Rock Mechanics Rock Engineering Mining Engineering Master's degree or PhD in Geotechnical Engineering or a related discipline is preferred. Chartered Engineer (CEng), Professional Engineer (PE), or equivalent professional registration is advantageous. Relevant professional registration in Qatar, Bahrain, or the UAE is preferred. Experience 8–15 years of relevant experience in geotechnical engineering. Proven experience in both geotechnical design and construction/site supervision. Strong understanding of contracts related to site investigations, surveys, and construction works. Experience on major infrastructure, transportation, marine, industrial, or building projects is highly desirable.

jobs.title: Growth Manager
jobs.description:
Careem is building the Everything App for the greater Middle East — making it easy to move around, order food and groceries, manage payments, and more. Our purpose is simple: to simplify and improve people’s lives and build an awesome organisation that inspires.
Since 2012, Careem has enabled earnings for over 2.5 million Captains, simplified the lives of more than 70 million customers, and built a platform where the region’s best talent and entrepreneurs thrive. We operate in 70+ cities across 10 countries, from Morocco to Pakistan.

We’re now entering our next chapter — one powered by AI. We’re looking for AI talent: curious problem-solvers who know how to apply AI to build tools, automate workflows, and create real impact. Whether it’s streamlining operations, enhancing customer experience, or reimagining internal systems — we want people who can make Careem work smarter and move faster.

About the role

This role leads the growth function for Careem Food in Dubai and, by extension, UAE. The Manager owns bottom-up planning, tracks performance against plan, designs and program manages growth initiatives, and ensures cross-functional alignment. This person is the primary bridge between the growth team and the commercial organisation, with direct accountability for ensuring Food hits its revenue targets in the market.

What you’ll do

Growth Planning & Bottom-Up Strategy

    • Own the bottom-up growth plan for Dubai/UAE – translating market opportunity into measurable targets across MAUs, OPU, ARPU, and revenue.
    • Build and maintain the quarterly and annual growth roadmap, ensuring tight alignment with organisational revenue goals.

Performance Tracking & Reporting

    • Own the performance rhythm for Dubai/UAE: weekly/monthly plan vs. actuals reviews, funnel health checks, and initiative-level tracking.
    • Build and maintain dashboards that surface the health of key growth metrics across the customer funnel.
    • Proactively diagnose gaps vs. plan, identify root causes, and drive corrective actions at pace.

Commercial Partnership & Revenue Accountability

    • Act as the primary growth point of contact for the Food commercial team – ensuring growth and commercial plans are tightly integrated.
    • Co-own revenue target delivery with the commercial team; design offers, incentives, and promotions that balance growth outcomes with unit economics.

Initiative Design & Execution

    • Design growth initiatives end-to-end across user acquisition, engagement, retention, and monetisation.
    • Lead A/B testing and experimentation frameworks to iterate and optimize initiatives across channels.

Program Management

    • Own the execution cadence for the Dubai/UAE growth portfolio: scoping, resourcing, launch timelines, and post-launch measurement.
    • Ensure initiatives are delivered on time with clear owners, milestones, and success metrics.
    • Manage cross-team dependencies and proactively escalate blockers to leadership.

Cross-Functional Stakeholder Management

    • Align Product, Engineering, Operations, and Marketing around the Dubai/UAE growth agenda.
    • Communicate growth performance and strategy clearly to senior stakeholders and leadership.

jobs.title: Senior BIM Engineer - Supervision
jobs.location: Abu Dhabi, UAE, United Arab Emirates
jobs.description: We are seeking an experienced Senior BIM Engineer to join our Construction Supervision team, supporting the digital delivery and coordination of major building projects. The successful candidate will be responsible for managing Building Information Modelling (BIM) processes throughout the construction phase, ensuring models remain coordinated, accurate, and aligned with project requirements. Working closely with the Resident Engineer, design consultants, contractors, and multidisciplinary site teams, the Senior BIM Engineer will oversee BIM implementation, model coordination, clash resolution, digital workflows, and information management to support efficient project delivery and informed decision-making. Responsibilities Lead the implementation and management of BIM processes throughout the construction supervision phase in accordance with project BIM standards and client requirements. Manage, review, and coordinate federated BIM models across architectural, structural, MEP, and specialist disciplines. Review contractor BIM execution plans, model submissions, and digital deliverables to ensure compliance with project requirements and industry standards. Facilitate multidisciplinary model coordination meetings, identifying and resolving clashes and interface issues before construction activities. Support construction teams by producing coordinated model views, digital construction sequences, quantity information, and visualisations where required. Monitor model quality, accuracy, and compliance with project naming conventions, level of development, and information requirements. Collaborate with architects, engineers, contractors, and subcontractors to ensure the timely exchange of accurate project information. Assist the Resident Engineer in monitoring construction progress using digital tools and BIM-enabled reporting where applicable. Ensure asset information and as-built models are developed and maintained in preparation for project handover. Provide technical guidance and mentoring to BIM Engineers, BIM Coordinators, and BIM Technicians. Prepare BIM progress reports, coordination logs, clash detection reports, and digital delivery metrics for project stakeholders. Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering, Architecture, Building Services Engineering, or a related discipline. BIM-related professional certifications are highly desirable. Minimum 10–15 years of professional experience, including at least 5 years managing BIM on major construction supervision projects.

jobs.title: Inspector - Structural (Steel)

jobs.description: Inspect steel erection, alignment, and fit-up for frames, trusses, bracing, platforms, and miscellaneous metal works against approved drawings and tolerances. Check high-strength bolting: bolt grades, storage/handling, installation methods (TC/SNUG/turn-of-nut), torque/tension verification, and calibration certificates. Review and witness surface preparation and protective coatings: cleanliness (e.g., SSPC/ISO), DFT measurements, curing, and holiday testing where applicable. Confirm material compliance: mill certificates, heat numbers, traceability, and correct section sizes/grades; verify shop/erection marks and traceability logs. Monitor dimensional tolerances and geometry: plumb, level, camber, sweep, and gaps; verify setting-out, base plate levels, grout, shims, and anchor bolt installation/tensioning. Review and implement ITPs, method statements, shop/erection drawings, and manufacturer technical data; raise queries for discrepancies. Conduct surveillance and hold-point inspections; issue and track IRs, MIRs, NCRs, and corrective actions to closure. Maintain daily site diaries, inspection checklists, photo records, redlines, and weekly progress/quality summaries. Coordinate with the Resident Engineer, Structural Engineer, QA/QC, HSE, and Contractor teams to resolve site issues promptly. Support lifting and installation activities: verify rigging plans, temporary works stability, and safe sequencing of erection. Verify fireproofing interfaces to steel (where applicable): surface readiness, adhesion tests, and compatibility with coatings. Assess and document site changes, RFIs, and as-built updates; support punch lists and handover documentation. Promote a proactive safety culture; stop and report unsafe conditions and ensure method statements and PTWs are followed. Diploma or Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering. Minimum 7–10 years of inspection experience on industrial, manufacturing, logistics, warehouse, or steel structure projects. Strong experience in structural steel fabrication and erection inspection. Experience in precast concrete installation and reinforced concrete foundation works. Experience in building envelope systems, cladding, roofing, and waterproofing inspections. Familiarity with QA/QC procedures, ITPs, NCR management, and material inspections

Careem is building the Everything App for the greater Middle East — making it easy to move around, order food and groceries, manage payments, and more. Our purpose is simple: to simplify and improve people’s lives and build an awesome organisation that inspires.
Since 2012, Careem has enabled earnings for over 2.5 million Captains, simplified the lives of more than 70 million customers, and built a platform where the region’s best talent and entrepreneurs thrive. We operate in 70+ cities across 10 countries, from Morocco to Pakistan.

We’re now entering our next chapter — one powered by AI. We’re looking for AI talent: curious problem-solvers who know how to apply AI to build tools, automate workflows, and create real impact. Whether it’s streamlining operations, enhancing customer experience, or reimagining internal systems — we want people who can make Careem work smarter and move faster.

About the Company

Careem is building the Everything App for the greater Middle East, making it easier than ever to move around, order food and groceries, manage payments, and more. Careem is led by a powerful purpose to simplify and improve the lives of people and build an awesome organisation that inspires. Since 2012, Careem has created earnings for over 2.5 million Captains, simplified the lives of over 70 million customers, and built a platform for the region's best talent to thrive and for entrepreneurs to scale their businesses. Careem operates in over 70 cities across 10 countries, from Morocco to Pakistan.

About The Team

The Careem Groceries team is transforming the way people shop for everyday essentials by offering a fast, reliable, and seamless Q-commerce experience. Within this fast-paced environment, the Category Management team is responsible for building the right assortment, pricing, and promotions that delight customers while driving business growth.

About The Role

As a Category Management Executive, you will support the grocery category team in managing assortment, sourcing, pricing, and promotions for the category. This role is ideal for someone who is passionate about the industry, has strong attention to detail, and is eager to grow their skills in category management and commercial operations.

What You'll Do

  • Support the Category Manager in executing category strategies aligned with business goals.
  • Assist in sourcing new products and maintaining the assortment for the category.
  • Coordinate with suppliers to gather product details, pricing, promotional offers, and manage day-to-day communication.
  • Track performance of your category – including sales, pricing, and stock availability – and flag risks or opportunities.
  • Help plan and execute weekly and monthly promotions in collaboration with suppliers and internal stakeholders.
  • Ensure accurate and timely listing of products, content, and images on the app in coordination with the content team.
  • Liaise with the supply chain team to support availability, smooth onboarding of new SKUs, and replenishment cycles.
  • Conduct market research to identify trends, new product opportunities, and benchmark pricing.
  • Maintain strong working relationships with key suppliers and help prepare for periodic business reviews.

What You'll Need

  • 2–3 years of experience within a retail or quick/ e-commerce environment.
  • Strong understanding of the market in the UAE

They will be expected to work well as part of a team and autonomously and know when to reach back to the office / line manager for additional support.   Job Duties   To achieve the highest standards of professional competence and to demonstrate this ability in all dealings with clients and professional contacts, reinforcing the profile of the firm. Ability to integrate with key members of the design team and Client team. Assist in evaluating claims. Measurement and quantification. Preparation of financial updates and monthly cost reports. Assesses and value progress payments and change requests. Review and compare scopes of work, production rates, and cost data. Preparation of earned value reports. Prepare, review, and update cash-flows. Estimate variation orders for Contractors/Subcontractors. Evaluate and negotiates variations and change orders in liaison with the Contract Administrator, Design and Construction Teams. Evaluate and negotiate final accounts settlements.   Specific Skills Required High level of literacy skills in English. Arabic speaking considered a benefit. Excellent working knowledge of industry best practices To be part of our commercial team on an Infrastructure and housing project Knowledge of cost and contract management techniques, budget management and change control Ability to present confidently Ability to act with discretion and safeguarding confidentiality of project data. Computer Literate, with specific experience in Cost Management software programs Person Specification (Personality Attributes) A dynamic, forward thinking person with the skills to self manage Presentable and personable, this individual will be a team player and comfortable with working in a large team and dynamic environment. Build successful working relationships with internal departments Ability to handle multiple tasks and establish priorities for the timely completion of work. High level of professionalism, initiative and creativity. Problem solving/lateral thinking skills. Must have a QS or Engineering degree or similar equivalent MRICS Preferable A minimum of 5 -8 years’ experience with large scale projects Experience in infrastructure and housing projects beneficial Communication and formal English language skills are considered essential.

jobs.description:
Careem is building the Everything App for the greater Middle East — making it easy to move around, order food and groceries, manage payments, and more. Our purpose is simple: to simplify and improve people’s lives and build an awesome organisation that inspires.
Since 2012, Careem has enabled earnings for over 2.5 million Captains, simplified the lives of more than 70 million customers, and built a platform where the region’s best talent and entrepreneurs thrive. We operate in 70+ cities across 10 countries, from Morocco to Pakistan.

We’re now entering our next chapter — one powered by AI. We’re looking for AI talent: curious problem-solvers who know how to apply AI to build tools, automate workflows, and create real impact. Whether it’s streamlining operations, enhancing customer experience, or reimagining internal systems — we want people who can make Careem work smarter and move faster.

About the role

As a Program Manager within the Product organisation, you will be the bridge that brings colleagues together to deliver complex, cross-functional technical initiatives — often with tight deadlines and multi-layered dependencies. You will build relationships grounded in trust and integrity across the organisation and with third-party partners, enabling you to break through collaboration barriers, resolve conflicts, and manage risks effectively.

This role sits within the Rides Product team, which leads product strategy and delivery for the Rides vertical to simplify mobility for customers. You will play a critical role ensuring complex programmes land on time, to a high standard, and with full visibility across the organisation — including across third-party integration boundaries.

What you'll do

  • Work closely with engineers, product managers, designers, researchers, data analysts, commercial leaders, and operations teams to conceptualise cross-functional initiatives with layered dependencies and plan their execution
  • Organise and align multiple stakeholders — including third-party partners — to drive timely, accountable execution
  • Develop a solid understanding of the technical architecture to exercise sound judgment on risks, trade-offs, and cross-team dependencies
  • Drive progress transparency through structured communication of status, blockers, and upcoming milestones across all levels of the organisation
  • Lead incident coordination, post-mortems, and closure of action items to build systemic resilience over time
  • Own go-live orchestration for major launches — including rollout gates, rollback triggers, and cross-functional readiness sign-offs
  • Track and flag resourcing risks to support delivery pace and quality
  • Maintain the programme's source of truth: decision logs, dependency registers, and status documentation
  • Contribute to process improvement within the programme scope — identifying friction points and proposing better ways of working
  • Support and contribute to tools and dashboards that surface delivery health, pace, and quality for the Rides vertical
  • Embed AI tooling into core programme workflows — synthesizing meeting intelligence, surfacing dependency risks, and maintaining high-quality stakeholder comms at pace — and actively raise the team's capability to do the same
